title: City of Moscow to host 21st Annual Artwalk Season Finale featuring fun for the whole family - NewsBreak
text: MOSCOW, Idaho — If you're looking for some summertime fun with the whole family, check out the upcoming Artwalk Season Finale in Moscow! On June 26, The City of Moscow and the Moscow Arts Commission will hold the 21st Annual Artwalk Season Finale. The event marks the culmination of the 2024-2025 Artwalk season, featuring a variety of visual, culinary, literary, and performing arts across multiple locations. A street fair along Main Street will include food, drinks and booths with work from local artists. Additional highlights include live music performances by Bart Budwig and Degler at Friendship Square, a Kidwalk area with family-friendly activities and a Public Works Fair showcasing creative tools and art from city departments. The event will take place from 4-8 p.m. and is free and open to the public. For more information, click HERE . COPYRIGHT 2025 BY KXLY. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.
